gloss: reluctant; unwilling; not in the mood

definitions.gloss: reluctant; unwilling; not in the mood for
definitions.explanation: Expresses a lack of enthusiasm or willingness to do something. Literally 'one's spirit does not advance.' Used when one feels unenthusiastic about an activity without necessarily having a strong reason to refuse.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{気|き}が{進|すす}まない。
examples.english: I'm not really feeling up to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}われた→誘う：01947_sasou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{気|き}が{進|すす}まなかった。
examples.english: I was invited to a drinking party, but I wasn't in the mood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{進|すす}まないんです。
examples.english: To be honest, I'm reluctant to take on that job.

notes:
One of many ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ expressions in Japanese. Always used in the negative — the positive form ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ is very rare.

USAGE:
A softer, more polite way to express reluctance than directly refusing. Useful when you want to decline without giving a firm "no."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{気|き}が{進|すす}まない (I'm not really feeling up to it)
- {気|き}が{進|すす}まない⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧ (I'm reluctant, but...)
- ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧{気|き}が{進|すす}まない (to be honest, I'm not keen)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乗|の}らない→乗る：00511_noru⟧: not in the mood (close synonym)
- {乗|の}り{気|き}⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧: not keen on it (more casual)
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be willing/motivated (positive counterpart)
